'''Mars Guo's Podracer''' was the [[Podracer]] operated by the [[Bardottan]] [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]], [[Mars Guo]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. 

==History==
Mars Guo [[pilot]]ed his podracer during the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] won by [[Anakin Skywalker]] in [[32 BBY]]. Among the leaders for the first two-thirds of the race, Guo held second position behind [[Sebulba]] through the second lap. Being positioned behind the [[Dug]] turned out to be costly for the [[Bardottan]], as Sebulba casually tossed a piece of scrap behind him which flew into one of Guo's [[engine]]s, causing it to explode. This made the racer crash which caused the cockpit to spin around, albeit upright, as the debris settled.<ref name="TPM" />
